snippet.description:
What difference does the right coaching institute make in your UPSC preparation?

Somya experienced GS Foundation at two different coaching institutes—first at another institute and later at LevelUp IAS. In this testimonial, she shares her experience and explains what stood out to her at LevelUp IAS, particularly in teaching, answer-writing guidance and personalised mentorship.

From understanding the UPSC syllabus to learning how to structure answers and getting guidance when preparation becomes stressful, discover what Somya valued about her GS Foundation experience at LevelUp IAS.

In this video, you'll learn about:

- The difference between her experiences at two GS Foundation institutes
- Why understanding the UPSC syllabus and exam requirements matters
- The role of answer-writing guidance in UPSC preparation
- How accessible faculty and mentors can support aspirants
- Why personalised guidance is important, especially for UPSC beginners

Preparing for UPSC CSE 2028?

Choosing the right GS Foundation programme is an important decision, particularly if you're starting your UPSC journey. Look beyond classroom lectures and consider the quality of teaching, syllabus coverage, answer-writing practice, doubt resolution and mentorship.

Explore the LevelUp IAS GS Foundation Course for UPSC CSE 2028 and learn more about our integrated preparation approach.

🔗 GS Foundation Course: https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-gs-foundation-course/
